title: Porch-light path from prompt to listening film
north_star: Let the guitar invitation and real family response carry the song; agents should expose choices, preserve uncertainty, and make only the smallest justified transformation.
assumptions: No external browsing, processing, public sharing, upload, or publication authority is inferred from this plan.
The supplied recordings and writing remain private until their exact intended uses are approved.
open_questions: Who participated in each recording and what visibility and credit wording will they approve?
Which original musical relationship deserves the first audible experiment?

steps.intent: Bind the supplied performances to their people, capture setups, room, consent context, and rights notes before editing.
steps.smallest_action: Create one recording-session spec that references the exact supplied takes without processing or duplicating them.
done_when: Every take has a role, participant relationship, setup, note, and honest rights context
No participant name or permission is guessed
steps.listening_question: What human timing, breath, room, or roughness must every later step preserve?

steps.intent: Study call-and-response and room relationships as abstract ideas without copying another work.
steps.smallest_action: Queue one bounded research pass, then normalize its sources, observations, interpretations, uncertainty, and copying boundaries.
outputs: One or two original experiment ideas
done_when: Every observation and interpretation cites its sources
Every finding states a musical consequence and copying boundary
steps.listening_question: Which relationship can be tested using only this project's own performances and material?

steps.intent: Translate the spoken boom-clap into player-facing timing evidence without assigning a grid or drum roles.
steps.smallest_action: Observe one complete phrase and describe attacks, spacing, pulse ambiguity, and performed push or relaxation.
done_when: The report distinguishes measured events from interpretation and names what must remain human
steps.listening_question: Where does the spoken phrase gather, wait, or answer?

steps.intent: Hear one original call-and-response relationship before committing to an arrangement.
steps.smallest_action: Freeze only the sources needed for one short A/B or one narrow listening hypothesis.
done_when: A complete listen records what the experiment revealed and the next smallest question
steps.listening_question: Does the answer feel invited and communal without the agents crowding or correcting it?

steps.intent: Develop only kept evidence into a reversible arrangement with conservative headroom.
steps.smallest_action: Write one declarative mix score using selected or explicitly processed sources and render a float working mix.
done_when: Every source role and transformation has a musical reason
The kept mix has deliberate balance, edges, decay, and headroom
steps.listening_question: Are the invitation, answer, breath, and room still the center of the complete song?

steps.intent: Prepare a stable lossless master and reviewed YouTube-format listening film without publishing either.
steps.smallest_action: Master the exact kept mix, approve it after a complete listen, render one title-card film, and watch picture and sync end to end.
done_when: Creative listen and picture/sync reviews are recorded
steps.listening_question: Did delivery preparation preserve the approved balance, dynamics, and ending?

steps.intent: Create a local handoff only after exact take, participant, credit, and proposed visibility decisions are verified.
steps.smallest_action: Record clearance for the traced raw takes and package approved media and metadata into FINAL without uploading.
done_when: Every traced raw take and participant is covered for the proposed visibility
steps.listening_question: Does the final local handoff represent the approved people, performances, credits, and song?

steps.intent: Separate a future explicit upload/publication decision from all local production work.
steps.smallest_action: Present the verified package, visibility, credits, and unresolved caveats to the user; do not upload.
outputs: Explicit user go/no-go decision for a separately authorized action
done_when: The user explicitly chooses whether any upload or publication action should occur
steps.listening_question: Is this the exact approved version and context the user intends to share?
